title: Which Box Hides the Diamond?
youtube_description:
Can YOU find the hidden diamond? Pick your box and see if you're right! New challenge every day on Kidify! 💎🎉

#Shorts #KidsYouTube #GuessingGame #DiamondChallenge #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleTime

scenes.narration: One of these boxes is hiding a GIANT diamond!
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the green box? Choose NOW!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue green gift boxes closeup

scenes.narration: Three… two… one… let's find out!
We open the RED box and… it's a rubber chicken! Nope, not today!
The BLUE box opens and… it's a smelly old sock! So close, but no!
That means the GREEN box has the diamond! Open it up… YES! There it is!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
